title: Improving insulin resistance by sulforaphane via activating the Bacteroides and Lactobacillus SCFAs–GPR–GLP1 signal axis
abstract: SFN alleviated IR via the Bacteroides and Lactobacillus-SCFAs–GPR41/43-GLP1 axis and protected the intestinal mucosal barrier, thereby, reducing the inflammatory response.
